_doc: HIFLD Control Areas (Balancing Authority territories), electric power. PUBLIC DOMAIN (US government work). Source mirror verified live 2026-09-11: https://services5.arcgis.com/HDRa0B57OVrv2E1q/arcgis/rest/services/Control_Areas/FeatureServer/0 (the documented services1.arcgis.com/Hp6G80Pky0om7QvQ mirror is dead/retired, confirmed 400 Invalid URL this session). Geometries server-side generalized (maxAllowableOffset=0.005 degrees, ~500m at mid-latitudes) to keep this file a reasonable repo size (43MB unsimplified -> ~1.5MB); adequate for plant-to-BA point-in-polygon assignment, not survey-grade. 71 features, CONUS+AK+HI. EIA-930 respondent crosswalk lives in scripts/grid_ba_polygon_join.py, not baked into these properties (properties here are the raw HIFLD attributes only).
